 ATP Lyon Day 3 Predictions Including Stan Wawrinka vs Martin Landaluce 
 Share Share this article
 × X Facebook LinkedIn WhatsApp Reddit Email Copy 
 A three-time Grand Slam champion will be returning to ATP Lyon for the first time in over two decades on what should be an entertaining day of tennis in France as the ATP season enters its final knockings. As always, we here at LWOT will be offering our predictions for every match on the slate, but who will advance and who will fall to defeat?
 ATP Lyon Day 3 Predictions
 Corentin Moutet vs Felix Balshaw
 Head-to-head: first meeting
 Corentin Moutet earned just his second career win in Lyon by beating countryman Ugo Humbert. It was also his second ATP match win since August. Even in the midst of a miserable season (11-21 record), there is still something to reflect on with immense hope. Felix Balshaw shocked Jaime Faria to register a win on his debut. The 20-year-old continues to build on his most recent success at the Mallorca Challenger, where he won his first title at that level. That said, I expect Moutet’s tactical variety to control this matchup.
 Prediction: Moutet in 2 
 Moise Kouame vs Lorenzo Musetti
 Head-to-head: first meeting
 This is probably the most exciting match on day three at ATP Lyon. Moise Kouame made waves at this year’s French Open with a big win over Marin Cilic. The 17-year-old produced an immaculate performance in beating Lorenzo Sonego in straight sets at the start of the week. Kouame saved all five break points in the match.
 Lorenzo Musetti recorded a more emphatic straight-sets victory over countryman Matteo Arnaldi for his first win since the US Open. Kouame has the energy and the home support to make this a very tricky afternoon for the higher-ranked Musetti. But the Italian’s brilliant slice should do enough damage. Musetti’s attacking depth should force Kouame to cover more court and defend.
 Prediction: Musetti in 2 
 Jul 31, 2025; Toronto, ON, Canada; Lorenzo Musetti (ITA) tracks a ball hit by Alex Michelsen (not pictured) during the third round at Sobeys Stadium. Mandatory Credit: John E. Sokolowski-Imagn Images 
 Tommy Paul vs Benjamin Bonzi
 Head-to-head: Paul 3-0 Bonzi
 Tommy Paul reached the quarterfinals in his last appearance at this tournament three seasons ago and is probably a better player now than he was back in 2023. Benjamin Bonzi opened up with a three-set win over Cameron Norrie. The Frenchman saved a late break-back point to complete a 6-3 3-6 6-3 win. Expect Paul to create more openings. Bonzi, for all his serving prowess, was broken twice by Norrie – that does not bode particularly well for his chances against the American at ATP Lyon. Paul’s movement and return quality make him a tough opponent to outmanoeuvre on this surface.
 Prediction: Paul in 3 
 Stan Wawrinka vs Martin Landaluce
 Head-to-head: Wawrinka 1-0 Landaluce
 Stan Wawrinka bids to end a three-match losing streak on his main draw debut at ATP Lyon. The Swiss legend’s last win came in mid-August at the Cancun Challenger . Martin Landaluce picked up his first title of the season at the Jinan Challenger last weekend. Wawrinka’s shot-making is still top-tier, but he struggles to sustain that intensity in longer matches. Landaluce is pushing to reach new heights before the end of the season and should be confident of extending his winning streak as he looks to build towards what looks like a pivotal 2027 for him.
 Prediction: Landaluce in 3
